question: Should the old LM Studio bridge remain the agent/chat contract, or should Archivist define a provider-neutral local agent interface with LM Studio as the first adapter?
recommended_answer: Define a provider-neutral local agent interface, with an LM Studio/OpenAI-compatible local endpoint as the first adapter.
answer: Define a provider-neutral local agent interface, with an LM Studio/OpenAI-compatible local endpoint as the first adapter.
rationale: The app remains local-first, but the interface should not freeze all future agent work to one provider implementation.
